requests.prompt: Create a production sprite atlas for a French Mass Effect 1 fan RPG using pre-rendered HD 2D sprites in an orthographic 3D world. EDIT/DERIVE FROM THE ATTACHED enemy-atlas.png: use ONLY the slim RED geth sniper, the THIRD character from the left on the TOP ROW. Do not draw any of the other seven enemies. Preserve this exact prototype identity: slender red segmented armor, narrow bent mechanical digitigrade legs and claw feet, dark flexible joints, forward-curved geth head, one small blue-white optical lens, a black corrugated tube arching from the head to its upper back. Its long sniper rifle stays a consistent generic illustrated rifle in all poses, with no exact model certification. This is the ME1 sniper variant, not a bulky destroyer, juggernaut, infiltrator cloak, or later-game geth. Camera is a fixed three-quarter orthographic view, facing toward image-left, with restrained semi-realistic pre-rendered materials, adult humanoid proportions, soft neutral upper-left light, and crisp isolated silhouette matching the attached game art. OUTPUT exactly one landscape 1536x1024 PNG with true transparent alpha and exactly FOUR separate complete figures of this ONE enemy arranged in a generous two-by-two layout. Reserve a minimum of 60 transparent pixels all around every figure and broad empty central gutters, no contact between neighboring cells. TOP LEFT: full standing aimed-rifle combat-ready pose, muzzle to left, feet completely visible. TOP RIGHT: full standing braced attack/action pose, rifle aligned to left, body slightly advancing, no projectile, energy effect or muzzle flash, feet completely visible. BOTTOM LEFT: full-body recoil from receiving an impact, torso leaning back and arm braced, same rifle retained, no impact spark or blood. BOTTOM RIGHT: defeated inert robot lying horizontally on the floor, head at LEFT and feet at RIGHT, whole body and rifle completely visible, no gore or debris; fit the full horizontal silhouette well within its quadrant with empty padding. All three upright figures should have consistent head/body/leg proportions and armor construction and about 350-380 pixels full height, with at least 60px top/bottom breathing space in each row. Lying figure should occupy about 600 pixels width with a low horizontal silhouette. Keep all content away from the atlas edges and central gutters. No typography, labels, numbers, borders, scenery, background shadow panel, checkerboard, rectangular glow, attached special effects, extra limbs or duplicate figures. These are four fixed key poses, not a complete animation cycle.
